name: realtor-ai-admin
description: The Agent Leverage OS — a real estate agent's AI executive assistant, 17 skills deep. The front door understands any admin ask in plain English, then the specialists take it: Scheduling (conflict-checked booking, guests invited, video link attached, reschedules and route planning), Inbox (drafts and replies in the agent's voice), the weekday Inbox Sweep, the 7am Briefing, Client Memory (total recall of every client, note, and promise), Meeting Prep, End-of-Day Wrap, on-the-go Dispatch (just talk while mobile — it captures, acts, and reports back), Match-Back (name a property and it finds the buyers already in their notes), Chase (who owes me? — every unanswered ask ranked, with nudge drafts), Tomorrow Confirmations (the no-show killer), Filing (attachments into client folders, found in seconds), Vendor Dispatch (book the photographer in one sentence), the Showing Feedback Chaser, and the Friday Scorecard (what slipped, with the fix drafted). REQUIRES the Realtor AI Brain plugin (same marketplace): install it and run 'Set up my Brain' first — the AI Admin reads everything from the Brain and never re-interviews the agent.
